name: egolimited
description: EGO LTD — property maintenance landing + field-service PWA + PHP/MySQL API. Deploys to soulrefresh.net/egolimited.

scripts.build: npm run build:landing && npm run build:app
scripts.lint: npm -w @egolimited/landing run lint && npm -w @egolimited/app run lint
scripts.deploy:landing: npm run build:landing && rsync -az --exclude app/ --exclude api/ --exclude images/ --exclude assets/ landing/dist/ cpanel:public_html/egolimited/ && rsync -az landing/dist/assets/ cpanel:public_html/egolimited/assets/
scripts.deploy:app: npm run build:app && rsync -az --delete app/dist/ cpanel:public_html/egolimited/app/
